info.name: MedFlow API - Sprint 1 & 2 (with RBAC & Patient Management)
info.description: Complete API collection for MedFlow Authentication, User Management, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and Patient Management Core (Sprint 2)

item.name: Authentication

exec: console.log("Check your email for the verification link. Click the link to set your password and activate your account.");

request.description: Initiate user registration by sending a verification link to the provided email. No password required at this stage. Optional roleId can be provided to assign a role during registration. If not provided, defaults to 'Patient' role. After successful registration initiation, user will receive an email with a link. When they click the link, they'll be taken to a page where they can set their password and activate their account.

Verify email token and set password to complete user registration. Requires the token from the verification link (extracted from URL query parameter) and the new password. Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character. On success, returns user data and authentication tokens. The verificationToken should be extracted from the email link query parameter.

exec: console.log("Check your email for the new verification link.");

request.description: Resend verification link to the email address. Use this if you didn't receive the link or it expired. The verificationEmail variable is automatically set after 'Register (Initiate)' request.
Login with email and password. Returns access and refresh tokens.
Refresh access token using refresh token. Returns new access and refresh tokens.
Get current authenticated user's profile with roles.
Logout user and invalidate access and refresh tokens. Optional refreshToken in body to also invalidate refresh token.

exec: console.log("Password reset code sent to: " + response.data.email);
console.log("Check your email or server console for the reset code");

request.description: Request password reset by sending a reset code to the provided email. The resetEmail variable is automatically set after this request.
Verify the password reset code. Use this to check if the code is valid before resetting the password. The resetEmail variable is automatically set after 'Forgot Password (Request Reset)' request.

exec: console.log("Password reset successfully! Please login with your new password.");

request.description: Reset password with new password. Requires email, reset code, and new password. The resetEmail variable is automatically set after 'Forgot Password (Request Reset)' request. After successful reset, all existing tokens are invalidated.

exec: console.log("Password reset code resent to: " + response.data.email);
console.log("Check your email or server console for the new reset code");

request.description: Resend password reset code to the email address. Use this if you didn't receive the code or it expired. The resetEmail variable is automatically set after 'Forgot Password (Request Reset)' request.

exec: console.log("Password set successfully! User account is now active.");

request.description: Set password for admin-created users. When an admin creates a user, the user receives an email with a verification link. When they click the link, they're taken to a password setup page. This endpoint is called from that page. Requires the token from the email link and the new password. Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character.

item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and token management

item.name: User Management

query.description: Search by email, first name, or last name

request.description: Get paginated list of all users. Admin only.
Get user details by ID. Users can only view their own profile unless they're an admin.
Update user information. Users can only update themselves unless they're an admin. Only admins can update isActive.
Update current authenticated user's own profile.
Change current user's password. Requires current password and new password.
Assign a role to a user. Admin only. Requires roleId in body.
Remove a role from a user. Admin only.
Delete a user account. Admin only. This will also remove all user roles.
Activate a user account. Admin only. Sets isActive to true.
Deactivate a user account. Admin only. Sets isActive to false and invalidates all existing sessions.

query.description: Search query (optional). Searches in action, tableName, ipAddress, and userAgent fields. Case-insensitive. Example: 'login' or 'created'
Start date filter (optional). ISO 8601 format. Filters activities from this date onwards. Example: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
End date filter (optional). ISO 8601 format. Filters activities up to this date (inclusive). Example: 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z

request.description:
Get user activity logs (audit logs). Admin only. Returns paginated list of all user activities including created, updated, deleted, and viewed actions. Supports search and date filtering.

**Note:** Set the `userId` environment variable or replace `{{userId}}` in the URL with an actual user ID (36-character UUID). The userId is automatically set after login, but you can also manually set it to view any user's activity (Admin only).

**Query Parameters:**
- `page` (optional): Page number (default: 1)
- `limit` (optional): Items per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `search` (optional): Search in action, tableName, ipAddress, userAgent fields
- `startDate` (optional): ISO 8601 date (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)
- `endDate` (optional): ISO 8601 date (e.g., 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z)

query.description: Search query (optional). Searches in eventType, description, and ipAddress fields. Case-insensitive. Example: 'login_success' or '192.168.1.1'
Start date filter (optional). ISO 8601 format. Filters login history from this date onwards. Example: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
End date filter (optional). ISO 8601 format. Filters login history up to this date (inclusive). Example: 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z

request.description:
Get user login history (security events). Admin only. Returns paginated list of login_success, login_failure, and session_end events with IP addresses and timestamps. Supports search and date filtering.

**Note:** Set the `userId` environment variable or replace `{{userId}}` in the URL with an actual user ID (36-character UUID). The userId is automatically set after login, but you can also manually set it to view any user's login history (Admin only).

**Query Parameters:**
- `page` (optional): Page number (default: 1)
- `limit` (optional): Items per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `search` (optional): Search in eventType, description, ipAddress fields
- `startDate` (optional): ISO 8601 date (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)
- `endDate` (optional): ISO 8601 date (e.g., 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z)

exec: console.log("User created successfully. Verification email sent to: " + response.data.user.email);

request.description: Create a new user account. Admin only. Creates an inactive user and sends a verification link to their email. The user must click the link to set their password and activate their account. No password is required at creation time. Optional roleId can be provided. If not provided, defaults to 'Patient' role.

item.description: User management endpoints for CRUD operations, role management, and activity tracking

item.name: RBAC & Permissions

request.description: Get all permissions for a specific user. Returns a set of all permissions from all user roles. Users can view their own permissions, admins can view any user's permissions.
Get all roles assigned to a specific user. Users can view their own roles, admins can view any user's roles.
Check if a user has a specific permission. Returns true if user has the permission, false otherwise. If userId is not provided, checks the authenticated user's permissions.
Get all active roles in the system with their permissions. Admin only. Useful for viewing available roles and their permission sets.
Get a specific role by ID with its permissions. Admin only.
Create a new role. Admin only. Requires roles.create permission.
Update a role. Admin only. Requires roles.update permission.
Delete a role. Admin only. Requires roles.delete permission.
Get all users assigned to a specific role. Admin only.

item.description: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) endpoints for managing roles, permissions, and checking user access

item.name: Patient Insurance (Sprint 2)

request.description: Get all insurance records for a patient. Optional query parameter: isActive (true/false).
Get patient insurance details by ID.

Link insurance to patient (primary/secondary/tertiary). Front Desk or Admin only. Required: insuranceCompanyId, policyNumber, subscriberName, subscriberDateOfBirth, relationshipToPatient, insuranceType, effectiveDate. If patient already has insurance of same type, it will be deactivated.

Delete patient insurance (soft delete - sets isActive to false). Front Desk or Admin only.

item.name: Patient Allergies (Sprint 2)

request.description: Get all allergies for a patient. Optional query parameter: isActive (true/false).
Get allergy details by ID.
Add patient allergy. Nursing, Doctor, or Admin only. Required: allergen. Optional: reaction, severity (mild/moderate/severe/unknown). Prevents duplicate allergens for same patient.
Update patient allergy. Nursing, Doctor, or Admin only. All fields are optional. If updating allergen name, checks for duplicates.
Delete patient allergy (soft delete - sets isActive to false). Nursing, Doctor, or Admin only.

item.description: Patient allergy management endpoints. Add, view, update, and remove patient allergies. Nursing, Doctor, and Admin roles.
